faq.title: A few things to know.
faq.audience.question: Who is the research for?
faq.audience.answer: People following Indian equity and derivatives markets who want to understand the reasoning, assumptions, and risks behind a research view. Consider whether the scope and risks suit your needs before subscribing.
faq.management.question: Does a subscription include portfolio management?
faq.management.answer: No. The service provides research and analysis. It does not include discretionary portfolio management, personalized financial planning, or trade execution.
faq.returns.question: Are investment returns guaranteed?
faq.returns.answer: No. Investments in securities markets are subject to market risks. You can lose capital, and past performance does not indicate future results.
faq.subscribe.question: How can I subscribe?
faq.subscribe.answer: Subscriptions are not open in this preview. Approved research plans, pricing, and enrollment terms will be published before you can create an account or make a payment.
